items.name: MSV Bike Trackdays
items.description: Operator track days at Brands Hatch, Donington Park, Cadwell Park, Snetterton, Oulton Park and Bedford. Open-pit-lane format; groups novice/intermediate/advanced. ACU CTC/BRA assessment dates available.

items.name: No Limits Trackdays
items.description: Novice-to-advanced bike track days and race schools across UK circuits including Brands, Donington and Cadwell. Strong progression bridge into club racing.

items.name: PDMCC Race School (Three Sisters)
items.description: One-day ACU race licence course (CTC theory + BRA on-track) at Three Sisters Circuit, Wigan. Cost approximately £155 (2024 figure). Widely recommended for first race licence.

items.name: Castle Combe Circuit — motorcycle track days
items.description: Experienced-rider track days at Castle Combe (Wiltshire); 9am–5pm format with 15-minute sessions. Also hosts club racing. Circuit phone 01249 782417.

items.name: Knockhill Racing Circuit — rider days and coaching
items.description: Track days and coach-led rider improvement days at Knockhill; Scotland's only motorsport complex. Group and 1:1 coaching available.

items.name: Anglesey Circuit (Trac Môn) — track days
items.description: Coastal and International layouts popular for motorcycle track days; scenic North Wales venue. Coaching sessions available through independent providers.

items.name: Phoenix Motorcycle Training
items.description: UK-wide motorcycle training school; track day and coaching programme as stepping stone from road to circuit.
